name: Ullastret (Spain)
description: Green field with the white masoned wall of the arms with two towers along the lower part, surmounted by a yellow olive tree.
history: The flag was approved on 17 December 2018 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 7773 of 21 December 2018; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, dark green, with the white masoned open wall of the arms 13/47 of the height placed 1/6 from the lower edge, with white towers.

features.role: masoned open wall with two towers, 13/47 of the height
wild olive (ullastre), the canting figure, above the wall
